name: 5/3/1 BBB Beefcake
progression_note: Add weight to BBB sets every 2 weeks; deload week 4.

name: 5/3/1 Boring But Big
progression_note: Add 5lb upper / 10lb lower to training max each cycle (4 weeks).

name: Advanced Bodybuilding Split
progression_note: Use double progression. Stay within rep range and add reps. When hitting top of range for all sets, increase weight by 2-5%.

name: Arm Specialization 4-Week
progression_note: Add a rep per set each week; superset opposing muscles for pump.

name: Athletic Power 4-Day
progression_note: Speed and quality first; never grind reps.

name: Athletic Strength & Conditioning Hybrid
progression_note: Aim to improve 1RM on main lifts, increase plyometric heights/distances, and shorten conditioning circuit times over the weeks.

name: Back Width & Thickness
progression_note: Add weight when you hit 12 reps on accessories.

name: Beginner Full Body Strength
progression_note: Aim to add 2.5-5lbs to the bar or increase reps each session. If new to training, prioritize excellent form.

name: Beginner Upper Lower 2x/Week
progression_note: Focus on learning proper form first. Once form is solid, aim to gradually increase weight or reps every week.

name: Bodybuilding Beginner Full Body
progression_note: Focus on controlling the weight and feeling the muscle work. Gradually add reps or increase weight by 2.5-5lbs when you consistently hit the top end of the rep range.

name: Bodybuilding Classic Split (High Volume)
progression_note: Focus on muscle mind connection and increasing overall volume. Utilize advanced techniques like supersets, dropsets, and pause reps.

name: Bodybuilding Intermediate Aesthetics
progression_note: Increase training volume or intensity by adding reps, sets, or moderate weight increases. Incorporate drop sets or supersets on isolation exercises.

name: Bodyweight Advanced Calisthenics
progression_note: Progress to harder variations of exercises. Focus on form, hold times for statics, and clean reps for dynamics. Incorporate weighted variations if possible.

name: Bodyweight Anywhere
progression_note: Progress by adding reps each week. When you can do 3x15, move to the harder variation of each exercise.

name: Bodyweight Beginner Strength
progression_note: Increase reps, decrease rest time, or progress to harder variations of exercises. Focus on perfect form before adding difficulty.

name: Bodyweight Intermediate Pull-Up Mastery
progression_note: Increase reps, decrease eccentric time, focus on harder variations (e.g., archer pull-ups), or add weighted vest if applicable.

name: Bro Split: Arms & Shoulders
progression_note: Increase reps, add dropsets or supersets, and occasionally bump up weight to maximize hypertrophy. Focus on time under tension.

name: Bro Split: Chest, Back, Legs
progression_note: Focus on increasing poundage or reps in each session. Explore advanced techniques like forced reps or rest-pause, but sparingly.

name: Bro Split: Chest & Triceps
progression_note: Focus on increasing total volume (sets x reps x weight) over time for each muscle group. Incorporate dropsets or supersets occasionally.

name: Bro Split Classic 5-Day
progression_note: Add 1-2 reps per set each week until you can add weight.

name: Bro Split: Minimal Equipment
progression_note: Increase reps, sets, or dumbbell weight when possible. Utilize slower eccentrics or pause reps for greater challenge.

name: Bro Split: Shoulders, Arms & Abs
progression_note: Focus on high-volume and isolation techniques. Implement dropsets, supersets, and controlled negatives to increase intensity.

name: Cardio + Lift Hybrid
progression_note: Increase cardio duration 5min per week; keep lifts heavy.

name: Chest & Back Specialization
progression_note: Add 1 rep per set weekly; deload after 4 weeks.

name: Circuit Training Burn
progression_note: Add a round each week; reduce rest 5s every week.

name: Classic PPL Hypertrophy
progression_note: Increase weight by a small increment (2.5-5lbs) when you can hit the top end of the rep range for all sets. Focus on progressive overload over time.

name: Classic PPL Intermediate
progression_note: Focus on progressive overload: increase weight, reps within the range, or decrease rest times. Vary exercise order occasionally.

name: Combat Athlete Conditioning
progression_note: Mirror fight rounds: 5min on, 1min off.

name: Conjugate (Westside) Intro
progression_note: Rotate main lifts every 3 weeks to avoid accommodation.

name: Couch to Gym (4-Week)
progression_note: Add 1 rep per set each session.

name: CrossFit-Style WOD Week
progression_note: Scale loads; aim to maintain intensity throughout.

name: Dumbbell Only Program
progression_note: Increase weight by smallest increment available when you can complete all sets at the top of the rep range.

name: Dumbbell Only 3-Day
progression_note: Add reps each week; upgrade dumbbells when reps too easy.

name: Dumbbell Only 5-Day Hypertrophy
progression_note: Double progression; buy heavier dumbbells when stalled.

name: EMOM Conditioning
progression_note: Increase reps per minute as conditioning improves.

name: Full Body 3x/Week Total Body
progression_note: Strive for linear progression by incrementally increasing weight on your main lifts each week. For accessories, add reps before weight.

name: Full Body Starter
progression_note: Add 2.5kg to all lifts each session. If you fail a weight 3 sessions in a row, deload by 10%.

name: Full Body Dumbbell Conditioning
progression_note: Increase dumbbell weight, reduce rest times between sets/circuits, or add an additional round to your workout. Maintain intensity.

name: Full Body Dumbbell Only
progression_note: Increase dumbbell weight, add reps/sets, or decrease rest periods between sets and exercises.

name: Full Body Fat Loss Circuit
progression_note: Reduce rest between exercises, add an extra round, increase reps, or bump up resistance for dumbbells.

name: Full Body Hypertrophy 4-Day
progression_note: Rotate variations daily; double progression on every lift.

name: Full Body Strength & Endurance (Advanced)
progression_note: Integrate advanced techniques like supersets for accessory work, or short, intense cardio bursts between sets of main lifts. Always aim for progressive overload on compounds.

name: Full Body Strength & Volume
progression_note: Periodize main lifts (e.g., 3-week waves of 6-8 reps, 4-6 reps, 2-4 reps). For accessory lifts, aim to add weight or extra reps weekly.

name: Functional Strength 50+
progression_note: Add weight slowly; quality of movement first.

name: Glute Focus 4-Day
progression_note: Add weight when reps hit top of range.

name: Greyskull LP
progression_note: Last set AMRAP. Add weight every session; reset 10% after 2 fails.

name: GZCLP Advanced
progression_note: T1: 5x3 → fail at 1+; T2: 3x10 → fail at 1+; T3: 3x15+ AMRAP.

name: HIIT Advanced Metabolic Circuit
progression_note: Increase rounds, decrease active rest, or add weight/resistance to bodyweight components. Aim to complete circuits faster.

name: HIIT Bodyweight Cardio
progression_note: Increase work interval duration, decrease rest interval duration, or add more rounds.

name: HIIT Fat Burner
progression_note: Reduce rest intervals by 5s each week. Increase work intervals by 5s every 2 weeks.

name: HIIT Fat Burner Circuit
progression_note: Decrease rest times, increase work duration, or add more rounds as fitness improves. Always maintain high intensity.

name: Home Workout Beginner Full Body
progression_note: Gradually increase the number of reps, add an extra set, or decrease the rest time between exercises. Focus on consistent effort.

name: Home Dumbbell & Bodyweight
progression_note: Increase dumbbell weight, add more reps/sets, reduce rest times, or try more challenging exercise variations.

name: Home Minimalist Strength
progression_note: Increase reps, sets, or time under tension. If you have resistance bands, incorporate them for added difficulty.

name: Hotel Room Workout (No Equipment)
progression_note: Add a round each week.

name: Ice Cream Fitness 5×5
progression_note: Add 5lb to compounds every session.

name: Kettlebell Fat Loss 4-Day
progression_note: Move up a bell size when sets feel easy.

name: Lean Body Recomp 12-Week
progression_note: Maintain calories at TDEE; progress lifts weekly.

name: Legs Specialization
progression_note: Add 5lb to compounds weekly; chase the pump on isolation.

name: Madcow 5×5
progression_note: Add 2.5lb upper / 5lb lower per week.

name: Metcon Shred 5-Day
progression_note: Aim to beat last week's time/rounds each session.

name: PPL Double Progression 6-Day
progression_note: Add 1 rep per set per week; add load when top of range hit.

name: Posture & Mobility 3-Day
progression_note: Focus on form and breathing; no load needed.

name: Powerbuilding Beginner Hybrid
progression_note: Start with manageable weights and add 5lbs to main lifts each week. For accessory work, focus on adding reps before increasing weight.

name: Powerlifting Beginner Template
progression_note: Focus on consistent, small increases in weight (2.5-5lbs) for the main lifts each session. Ensure excellent form before adding load.

name: Powerlifting Peaking Program
progression_note: Follow prescribed percentages of 1RM. Weeks 1-8 build strength, weeks 9-12 focus on specific singles/doubles, reducing volume, deloading.

name: Powerlifting Raw Strength
progression_note: Aim for consistent 2.5-5lb jumps on main lifts weekly. If a weight is missed, reduce it slightly or maintain until successful.

name: Powerlifting Sheiko-Style Peaking
progression_note: Strictly follow prescribed percentages of 1RM and adjust only if performance dictates. This program heavily relies on planned wave loading and deloads.

name: PPL Arnold-Style 6-Day
progression_note: Double progression — add reps then weight on every lift.

name: PPL Beginner Program
progression_note: Focus on perfecting form first. Then, add reps or a small amount of weight (2.5lbs) when all sets are completed with good form.

name: PPL Fat Loss & Conditioning
progression_note: Focus on decreasing rest times and increasing the total volume of work completed in the session. Gradually increase cardio intensity or duration.

name: Push Pull Legs — Hypertrophy
progression_note: Add 2.5kg to compound lifts every 2 weeks. Increase isolation reps by 1 each week until you hit the top of the range, then increase weight.

name: PPL Strength Powerbuilding
progression_note: Alternate between heavy compound movements (low reps) and accessory work (higher reps). Track weights and aim to increase load or reps weekly.

name: PPL Strength Volume
progression_note: Utilize undulating periodization. Vary rep ranges and intensities weekly (e.g., heavy week, moderate week, light week for main lifts). Incorporate advanced techniques like rest-pause on accessories.

name: Pre/Postnatal Friendly Strength
progression_note: Listen to your body; stop any exercise that feels wrong.

name: Pull-up Bar Only Plan
progression_note: Add reps weekly; weight up once you can do 12+ pull-ups.

name: Resistance Band Full Body
progression_note: Use heavier band or slower tempo when reps too easy.

name: Sheiko #29 (Beginner)
progression_note: Track percentages of competition 1RM. Test after 8 weeks.

name: Shoulder Specialization
progression_note: Add 1 rep per set weekly; rotate pressing variations.

name: KB Simple & Sinister
progression_note: Goal: 100 one-handed swings (10x10) + 10 TGUs in under 30 min.

name: Smolov Jr. Bench
progression_note: Week 1: 70%, Week 2: 75%, Week 3: 80% of 1RM.

name: Speed & Agility 3-Day
progression_note: Full recovery between sprints; coach form.

name: Basketball Conditioning Program
progression_note: Increase jump height, decrease sprint times, add resistance to bodyweight exercises, or increase duration of conditioning drills.

name: Football Pre-season Strength
progression_note: Increase total yards covered in sprints, reduce rest between conditioning drills, increase weights on main lifts, and improve plyometric height/distance.

name: Martial Arts Conditioning
progression_note: Increase rep counts for bodyweight, add sets for circuits, decrease rest periods, or incorporate heavier resistance with dumbbells/bands.

name: Starting Strength Linear
progression_note: Add 5lb upper / 10lb lower every session until you stall twice.

name: Classic 5×5 Strength
progression_note: Add 2.5kg to every lift every session. When you stall, deload by 10% and work back up.

name: Strength 5x5 Linear Progression
progression_note: Add 5lbs to the bar for each working set every workout, as long as you successfully complete all 5 sets of 5 reps. If you miss reps, repeat the weight next time.

name: Strength Hybrid Powerbuilding Intermediate
progression_note: Cycle through intensity phases (e.g., 5x5, 3x5, 1x3) for main lifts. For accessory work, focus on increasing reps or sets before weight.

name: Strength Olympic Weightlifting Prep
progression_note: Focus on perfecting form and technique in the classic lifts with light weight before gradually increasing. Accessory work can be progressed via typical linear methods.

name: StrongLifts 5×5 Refined
progression_note: Add 5lb each session; if you fail 3x same weight, deload 10%.

name: Tabata 4-Week Shred
progression_note: Add 1 Tabata block each week.

name: Texas Method
progression_note: Add 5lb to Friday's PR every week until stall, then reset.

name: Upper/Lower 5-Day Hybrid
progression_note: Linear progression on strength lifts, double progression on accessories.

name: Upper Lower Advanced Power & Hypertrophy
progression_note: Utilize undulating periodization – vary intensity and volume week to week. Focus on small, consistent strength gains on main lifts and progressive overload on accessories.

name: Upper Lower Beginner Simple
progression_note: Master the movement patterns first, then add 5lbs to compound lifts weekly. For accessory exercises, increase reps before increasing weight.

name: Upper Lower Intermediate
progression_note: Aim for a small increase in weight or reps each week. Focus on compound movements and maintain strict form.

name: Upper Lower — Strength Focus
progression_note: Follow a weekly linear progression of 2.5kg on upper lifts and 5kg on lower lifts. Deload every 4th week.

name: Upper Lower Strength & Hypertrophy
progression_note: Alternate between strength-focused (lower reps, higher weight) and hypertrophy-focused (higher reps, moderate weight) days for each body part.

name: Upper Lower Volume Focus
progression_note: Strive to increase total volume (sets x reps x weight) over time. Utilize progressive overload on compound movements and chase the pump on isolation exercises.

name: Vertical Jump Program
progression_note: Strict form on plyos. Quality > quantity.
